Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Interactive PvP combat frames, reliable held-action scheduling, LB cues, and survival helpers.
Description: A local PvP HUD with fixed Self/S1-S5 combat frames, optional exact row targeting and mouseover, calibrated LB gauges, direct ally LB damage, pressure and CC cues, a bounded held-action scheduler, reactive counter-CC, survival and job helpers, explicit PvP macros, low-MP Focus, assists, team communication, and target highlights.
Changelog: Simplifies the explicit NIN /panicshu macro into one immediate Shukuchi request at the terrain point 19.5 yalms along the character's facing. It is intentionally allowed from own Guard so Shukuchi may break it. The former pending state, 500-ms lease, scheduler/Purify priority, wait, expiry, cast/queue/animation-lock gate, cooldown/resource precheck, and routine chat-result messages are removed. Every macro press is one independent user command; FFXIV immediately accepts or rejects its sole native request, with no automatic retry or replay. Exact PvP NIN/context/metadata checks, opt-in Wolves' Den testing, the Three Mudra/Doton block, terrain proof, and no cursor/target mutation, shorter fallback, alternate action, or destination recomputation remain. Schema 30 is unchanged.
